notes.title: A very minor final update
notes.notes:
Last update for SnOut 1, because SnOut 2 is here! Changed the button at the top of the page from "wishlist" to "purchase" ;)

Thanks for all the support over the past 9 months, we were just a couple hundred away from 15,000 leaderboard entries which is incredible!

Here's to the future, and thanks for playing!

notes.title: 1.2.3.2 - Audio Fix and Version numbers
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Another quick fix to solve the problem of music duplicating every reset. 
In addition, I have also added the current version number to the bottom of the screen so there's no doubt about which version you're running.

Thanks!

notes.title: 1.2.1.4 - Discord Link Hotfix
notes.notes: It has been pointed out to me that the Discord link previously only worked in Firefox, this issue should now be fixed with the latest update.
